headword: {株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい}

definitions.gloss: general meeting of shareholders; shareholders' meeting
definitions.explanation: The meeting at which a company's shareholders vote on major matters such as the accounts, dividends and the election of directors. In Japan most listed companies hold their annual meeting in late June.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧、{株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The shareholders' meeting will be held next week.

examples.japanese: {株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new president was approved at the shareholders' meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{配当|はいとう}→配当：05970_haitou⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: At this year's shareholders' meeting, many questions were asked about dividends.

examples.japanese: {株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{本社|ほんしゃ}→本社：09565_honsha⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the head office to attend the shareholders' meeting.
